meta.name: Track game prices and deals from Discord using IsThereAnyDeal

parameters.content:
## Discord Game Watchlist & Tracking System

### How it works

1. Listens for Discord slash commands via a webhook, parses them, and routes to the appropriate command handler.
2. For search commands it queries the IsThereAnyDeal (ITAD) API, builds an interactive reply and (optionally) saves a watch entry.
3. For list/alert/clear/unwatch/help commands it loads user data, formats a response and sends it back to Discord.
4. On a six-hour schedule it loads active watches, fetches prices from ITAD, normalizes and compares them, and sends alerts when rules match.
5. Sent alerts and price-history updates are recorded to data tables to avoid duplicate notifications and keep history up to date.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Add and configure the Discord webhook / bot credentials used by the Discord nodes (send and admin-notify).
- [ ] Add the IsThereAnyDeal (ITAD) API key and set it in the HTTP request nodes used for search, prices and history.
- [ ] Configure the dataTable nodes with your database or n8n built-in data storage credentials (watchlist, price history, sent alerts).
- [ ] Ensure the schedule trigger is enabled and set to the desired interval (default: every 6 hours).
- [ ] Verify channel IDs and any environment variables referenced by custom code nodes (message templates, thresholds).

### Customization

Adjust the alerting criteria (thresholds or percentage drops) in the Compute & Compare node and change the schedule frequency or Discord message templates in the build/format code nodes.

## Receive and route commands

Webhook entry that parses incoming Discord commands and routes them to command-specific branches.

## Search ITAD and match

Searches ITAD for the queried game, extracts best match, retrieves current and historical prices, and builds an interactive response; errors notify admin.

## Build not found reply

Creates the Discord reply when no matching game is found.

## Send Discord reply

Single Discord node that posts built replies back into the original Discord channel.

## Save to watchlist

Decides whether a found game should be saved and persists it to the watchlist table.

## Unwatch flow

Deactivates a watch entry and builds the confirmation reply for unwatch requests.

## Format watchlist response

Loads a user's watchlist and formats the message for Discord.

## Format alerts response

Loads a user's configured alerts and formats them for display.

## Clear confirm and clear

Handles the 'clear all' confirmation check, clears the user's watchlist and builds confirmation replies.

## Build help

Constructs help text shown to users when requested.

## Scheduled fetch kickoff

Schedule trigger that loads active watches, compiles unique game IDs and requests current prices from ITAD.

## Fetch and normalize prices

Fetches historical lows, normalizes API price responses and loads local price history for comparison.

## Compute and update watchlist

Loads sent-alerts, computes comparisons to determine changes, updates last-checked metadata and compiles games for history updates.

## Alert filter and send

Filters computed results to items that should trigger alerts, sends Discord alerts and records which alerts were sent.

## Update price history

Assembles the list of games for history and persists updated price-history records.

=⚠️ Automation Error

Workflow: Discord Game Watchlist
Service: IsThereAnyDeal
An ITAD API request failed. Check the latest execution for details.
Time: {{ $now.toISO() }}

Number(l.low.amount) : null; }); const out = []; (Array.isArray(pr) ? pr : []).forEach((g) => { const deals = (g.deals || []).slice().filter((d) => d && d.price).sort((a, b) => Number(a.price.amount) - Number(b.price.amount)); const best = deals[0]; if (!best) return; const entry = wl.find((r) => String(r.itad_game_id) === String(g.id)); if (!entry) return; out.push({ json: { game_id: g.id, game_name: nameById[g.id] || g.id, store: best.shop ? best.shop.name : '', current_price: Number(best.price.amount), regular_price: best.regular ? Number(best.regular.amount) : null, discount_percent: best.cut != null ? Number(best.cut) : 0, currency: best.price.currency || 'INR', store_url: best.url || '', itad_history_low: lowById[g.id] != null ? lowById[g.id] : null, user_id: String(entry.user_id || ''), username: String(entry.username || ''), guild_id: String(entry.guild_id || ''), channel_id: String(entry.channel_id || ''), forum_id: String(entry.forum_id || ''), thread_id: String(entry.thread_id || '') } }); }); return out;
